items.raw_desc:
Adalék EUROL Engine Oil Treat 250 ml:
	

	
	
	
	EUROL Engine Oil Treat is an additive developed to create a stronger and tougher lubricating film between moving engine parts. The product reduces metal-to-metal contact in the engine by using carefully selected synthetic base oils and advanced additives. It increases the oxidation stability of the engine oil, preventing it from oxidising at extremely high temperatures and allowing it to perform for longer. EUROL Engine Oil Treat provides extra cleaning properties to the oil, significantly reducing friction and increasing performance, which leads to fuel savings. The additive is compatible with all commercially available oils for petrol and diesel engines.
    


	

	
	
    
	
		
		
	

    
    
    


	Key features of EUROL Engine Oil Treat additive, 250ml
	
	
	
		
			Creates a stronger oil filmReduces friction between metal partsIncreases oxidation stabilityEnables oil to perform at higher temperaturesReduces fuel consumptionUses engine oil as a carrier fluid to reach the relevant engine parts
